text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. A seasonal event held
with the goal of making massive leaps in ability, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, summer training camp really lifts your spirits, doesn't it~?
It feels like a seaside school trip or a class excursion.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What should we do, what should we do? Maybe we could all do fireworks, or light some incense on the porch?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a mystery okonomiyaki party sounds fun too~♪
Like, 'Whoaa, who put a croquette in here~?'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer?
What's this paper? Is it a recipe for dark okonomiyaki?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not a recipe... I handed her this summer's training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ge-geh~, what's with this menu?!
Isn't this way too brutal~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Can you really call this a seaside school trip
or a school excursion~?
Do you even intend to call it that~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The top priority for this menu
was for Hishi Miracle
to 'actually feel the results of her hard work.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I intentionally made some tweaks
so that the intensity can be felt even more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You meanie, demon, English teacher, Trainer!
That's so cruel~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? I might end up
hating you, Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, the summer heat made Trainer
turn super ripped and veiny~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what anyone thinks. It hurts to be
disliked, but it was all for Hishi Miracle's sake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Sneeeak, sneeeak...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (PEEEEEP!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I was wondering if there was a convenience store nearby...
And also... if there are any trains running, maybe?
choice_data_list: Deserters get twenty percent extra training.
Deserters get twenty percent extra training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I shouldn't have gone along with it~
My friends just talked me into it~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't let them off the hook.
I'll have them work their hardest this summer.
